Privacy & cookie choices

How Raj Defence & Aerospace handles information from this website.

Website enquiries

When you submit an enquiry, we use the contact details, organisation and message you provide to respond and coordinate your request. Avoid including sensitive information in your enquiry.

The site is hosted on Vercel. The online form uses Web3Forms to forward enquiries to the Raj team. The service limits submission attempts to prevent abuse. Messages sent directly to our email are handled by the Raj team.

Optional analytics

When enabled on this site, Google Analytics measures page visits and device and browser information after you accept. Your choice is stored in your browser. Use Cookie settings to change your choice at any time.

Contact about privacy

Raj Defence & Aerospace, Pune, Maharashtra, India. For questions about your information or this notice, email sales@rajprocess.com.
